## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations mixed — SPY (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +12.24%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +21.50%) ABOVE TREND show equity strength while VXX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: -28.11%) BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD mixed (HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +2.02%) CORRECTION) offset, leaving a neutral read.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Volatility easing: VXX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: -28.11%) ↓ falling and BELOW TREND points to lower fear. Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +2.63%) → flat ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +2.02%) CORRECTION, so credit not decisively directional.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral to slightly supportive: UUP (1W: +0.22% | 1M: -1.11%) RECOVERY while TLT (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +1.26%) CORRECTION suggests little net pressure on risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +21.50%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +35.62%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; Energy bifurcated with XLE (1W: +3.29% | 1M: -7.75%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +4.44%) ABOVE TREND. Defensives showing pockets of life: Utilities (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +1.13%) positive but overall breadth narrow.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperformance but not dominant: SPY (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +12.24%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +14.11%) ABOVE TREND signals EM participation; China FXI (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +4.02%) CORRECTION lags.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative assets active: IBIT (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.49% | 1M: +16.74%) CORRECTION show rotation within high-volatility trades; IWM (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +12.67%) CORRECTION flags small-cap short-term hesitation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base metals mixed: CPER (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION after recent gains; gold GLD (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION on profit-taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strength on macro headlines: BNO (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +4.44%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +3.29% | 1M: -7.75%) RECOVERY, while nat-gas UNG (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -15.88%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership — XLK (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +21.50%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCE: multiple correction flags (ARKK, IWM, XBI) constitute a MINOR divergence set; monitor if corrections broaden.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech/semis and EM participation given ABOVE TREND signals (XLK, SOXX, EEM); reduce exposure to assets showing short-term correction dynamics (ARKK (1W: -2.49% | 1M: +16.74%) CORRECTION, XBI (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +9.67%) CORRECTION). Bonds neutral-to-hedging as TLT (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +1.26%) CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology — XLK (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +21.50%) ABOVE TREND; Semiconductors — SOXX (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +35.62%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Communication Services — (sector breadth 1W: -4.19% | 1M: -2.73%) showing weakness; watch Biotech XBI (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +9.67%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/Oil — BNO (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +4.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -15.88%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX at ~20 (volatility complacency trigger) with VXX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: -28.11%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD spread near 0.80 (credit health watch) with HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +2.02%) CORRECTION; XLK/XLF gap (XLK (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +21.50%) ABOVE TREND vs XLF (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +10.15%) CORRECTION) as rotation pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Tech and semiconductors showing strength (XLK (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +21.50%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +35.62%) ABOVE TREND) while a cluster of corrections (ARKK (1W: -2.49% | 1M: +16.74%) CORRECTION; IWM (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +12.67%) CORRECTION) is the key divergence to monitor.
